where: A home in the City of Greensboro, Guilford County.
input_label: Assessed value of your home (2022 revaluation values still apply)
split_note: Each government’s share is one slice unless it publishes a debt split.
rollback_note: A one-year state moratorium (Senate Bill 889) blocked Guilford County’s 2026 revaluation, so FY2027 bills use the old values — which is why both rates rose. A revenue-neutral rate applies only in a revaluation year.
hearing: The county and city adopt their rates with the budget each June.
limits: North Carolina’s elderly, disabled and veteran relief programs aren’t modeled.
